glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

instructions: Translate every "en" string into Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), game-guide register. Follow glossary.json strictly. Keep ⟦0⟧-style placeholders, numbers, units and wiki markup exactly. Return only {"items":[{"k":"...","zh":"..."}]} with the same k values.

units.en: remove_building = { type = arms_factory level = 5 } remove_building = { tag = facility level = 1 }
Removes the specified building in the current state. For shared buildings level determines the amount, whereas for the others it is the actual level.
Set building level in a random province of state scope.
Adds compliance to the specified state.
Adds resistance to the specified state.
Increases resistance target in the specified state.

⟦0⟧ The ID of the target increase. ⟦1⟧ The amount to increase the resistance target by. ⟦2⟧ Will only apply the increase if the the occupied country is the specified scope. ⟦3⟧ Will only apply the increase if the the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦4⟧ If set, the resistance target will only be increased for the specified amount of days. ⟦5⟧ The tooltip to show in the resistance target tooltip.
add_resistance_target = { id = 123 amount = 30 occupied = ENG occupier = GER days = 365 tooltip = my_localisation_key }
Cancels resistance activity for the current state.
Disables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.
⟦0⟧ If set to yes, will clear resistance. ⟦1⟧ Resistance will be disabled if the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦2⟧ Resistance will be disabled if the occupied country is the specified scope.
force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = GER occupied = ENG }
Enables resistance for the scoped state when the occupier is the specified country.
Does not start resistance by itself, only removes the checks forcefully disabling it. Use with ⟦0⟧ in order to immediately start resistance.
⟦0⟧ If set to yes, will clear resistance. ⟦1⟧ Resistance will be enabled if the occupier is the specified scope. ⟦2⟧ Resistance will be enabled if the occupied country is the specified scope.
force_enable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = GER occupied = ENG }
⟦0⟧ The id of the resistance target to remove. (Must be set with add_resistance_target)
Removes a set resistance target increase in the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The amount to set the compliance to.
Sets compliance in the specified state.
⟦0⟧ The amount to set the resistance to.
Sets resistance in the specified state.

The resistance should be enabled in the state, either via ⟦0⟧ or through the in-game process. Occassionally it may take a tick for resistance to start after the controllership change, so it's preferable to do so on states that are given to the country immediately before this gets executed, such as if this is executed in country history.
⟦0⟧ Whether to start resistance or not. If using a country as the parameter, the state will only start resistance if occupied by the target country.
Starts resistance in the specified state.
If used on a state that normally can't start resistance, use alongside with ⟦0⟧.
Sets the strength of the garrison in the specified state.
GER = { every_controlled_state = { set_occupation_law = military_governor_occupation } } # Changes GER's occupation law for every controlled state.
Sets the occupation law of the state.

⟦0⟧ will be the country for whom the occupation law will be changed. If PREV is not a country, nothing changes. If PREV doesn't occupy the state, nothing happens until it does. If using ⟦1⟧, resets to the law set by the country's occupation. Can also be used in country scope.

Reduce progress to the special project in state. Root scope is raid instance scope. The input value is a ratio of the total needed progress to complete the special project, i.e. a decimal number between 0 and 1.

⟦0⟧ An unique string to identify the character flag with. OR flag = <flag> The flag to set. days = <int> Sets the flag to last for the specified amount of days. Optional. value = <int> The new value of the flag on the scale from -2 147 483 648 to 2 147 483 647.
set_character_flag = my_flag set_character_flag = { flag = my_flag days = 123 value = 1 }
Changes the character's name to the specified localisation key's value.
Switches the current character to the specified country, giving them the character.

⟦0⟧ The character name. Optional if in character scope. Army scope: small = <sprite> The sprite used as an advisor. large = <sprite> The sprite used as a general. Character scope:large = <sprite> The sprite used as a country leader.
set_portraits = { character = my_character army = { small ="MySmallCharacterGFX" } civilian = { large ="MyLargeCharacterGFX" } }
Changes the specified portraits of a character.
⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to add.
add_trait = { slot = political_advisor trait = really_good_boss } add_trait = { ideology = liberalism trait = field_of_gar }

Ideology type refers to a sub-type of an ideology group assigned to characters, commonly referred to as sub-ideologies in community jargon. The character slot can be the character's name or id. Using name is recommended because 1.11 made id obsolete.
⟦0⟧ Slot of the character. Necessary for advisors. ideology = <sub-ideology> Ideology type of the character. Necessary for country leaders. trait = <trait> The trait to remove.
